name: Klaus-Dieter Richter
bio:
Klaus-Dieter Richter's journey in motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's autobody shop. After graduating with a degree in mechanical engineering, he joined a small Formula 3 team, rapidly ascending through the ranks. His meticulous approach to problem-solving and knack for optimizing performance quickly established him as a valuable asset. He believes in a data-driven approach, constantly seeking marginal gains through rigorous analysis and innovative solutions.

His career has seen him contribute to multiple championship-winning teams, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible. While he's known for his technical expertise, Klaus-Dieter also possesses a strong understanding of team dynamics and knows how to effectively manage and motivate his staff. His ability to adapt to changing circumstances and maintain a cool head under pressure sets him apart, making him a sought-after leader in the high-stakes world of motorsport. He joined Brasil Racing hoping to bring his expertise to a new racing scene.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: A stocky man with a serious demeanor, Klaus-Dieter always looks like he's deep in thought.

quirks: Always carries a worn-out slide rule, even though he uses a computer.
Has a specific brand of gummy bears he eats during races.
Meticulously cleans his workspace every evening before leaving.
